text.es: Yo no quiero vivir si no es contigo a mi lado. Quiero que seas mi mujer. Y estoy dispuesta a enfrentarme a lo que sea, a lo que sea, para tenerte a mi lado.
text.en: I don't want to live if it's not with you by my side. I want you to be my wife. And I'm willing to face whatever it takes, whatever it takes, to have you by my side.
